messages:
Alex (Security): FYI: external pentest booked May 3 09:30 UTC. Scope includes KMS-proxy endpoints, admin RBAC paths, and our audit/trace exports. Need owners for: evidence ops, KMS policy, and retest slot. Suggest short live-fire contingency plan too.
Maria (SecOps): Ill take evidence ops. Prefer a small "reading room" for highest-sensitivity artifacts (no downloads), with presigned links for everything else. Will list manifest items shortly.
Jordan (SRE): Reading room + presigned hybrid is sensible. For backups we should also enable continuous CloudTrail -> dedicated bucket with 60d retention and object lock for the window.
Sam (Eng-Infra): KMS question: we'll stand up an assessor-specific key alias (alias/pt_assessor_key) that allows Decrypt and Describe only. We should disable automatic rotation for 48h around the test. Anyone object?
Maria (SecOps): No objection. Draft key policy here (will add to JIRA):
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowAssessorDecryptOnly",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {
        "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/assessor_ephemeral"
      },
      "Action": [
        "kms:Decrypt",
        "kms:DescribeKey"
      ],
      "Resource": "*",
      "Condition": {
        "IpAddress": {
          "aws:SourceIp": "198.51.100.0/24"
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}
```
Jordan (SRE): Add an explicit Deny for kms:ReEncrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey so assessors can't create new ciphertexts. Also we'll capture KMS API logs at DEBUG for the window.
Lee (Oncall): Contingency play: if a confirmed exploit occurs during the test -> immediate bridge via #incidents, revoke assessor_ephemeral role, take EBS snapshots, flip traffic to standby, and run postmortem template. I'll keep a 1-page checklist.
assessor-bot: Access window confirmed May 3 09:30-12:30 UTC. Ephemeral creds will be minted T-5m.
Alex (Security): Good. Maria -- can you create artifacts_manifest.csv and put it in s3://pt-evidence/4210000000/manifest.csv with pointer to the reading-room? Also confirm which items are read-only.
Maria (SecOps): Done (manifest uploaded). Reading room will contain: core audit logs, KMS access logs, and anonymized DB snapshots. Screenshots and stack traces will be presigned.
Sam (Eng-Infra): I'll provision alias/pt_assessor_key, create s3://pt-evidence/4210000000/, and enable object-lock on the trail bucket for the window. Presigned link TTL = 36h.
Jordan (SRE): I'll run a dry export on May 2 18:00 UTC to validate the trail -> SIEM pipeline and confirm alerting for unusual KMS calls.
Alex (Security): Propose retest slots May 6 morning or May 9 afternoon. Which gives time for fixes?
Sam (Eng-Infra): May 9 14:00 UTC works for infra patches.
Alex (Security): Locked: May 9 14:00 UTC for retest. I'll add retest checklist to the pentest JIRA and calendar.
Maria (SecOps): Operational notes: label any RBAC or infra PRs with "pt:change" and set CI to emit audit-log annotation so we can correlate changes to the timeline.
Lee (Oncall): Confirmed. If we need to escalate, page me and I'll open the incident bridge.
Alex (Security): Owners summary: Maria evidence + manifest, Sam KMS/infra, Jordan exports/alerts, Lee oncall. assessor-bot will handle creds. Thanks everyone.
